login_pitch_notebook_f3_body: Noonya buli kimu, okusinziira ku kitabo, ku buli kyuma.
login_pitch_sample_quote: Obwetoowaze, ekifo eky'okwesigama kwonna ku Katonda, mu butonde bw'ebintu bwennyini, [[gwe mulimu ogusooka era obutuukirivu obusingira ddala obw'ekitonde]], era gwe muzi gwa buli butuukirivu.
about_meta_description: Ochorus kitongole ky'obuweereza ekiri mu Victoria BC, Canada, ne Kampala, Uganda, ekifulumya ebitabo by'Ekikristaayo eby'edda okusomebwa ku mutimbagano awatali kusasula, era ne kitwala ebitabo ebikube mu Afirika ya Buvanjuba.
about_p1: Ng’esangibwa mu Victoria BC, Canada ne Kampala, Uganda, Ochorus buweereza obwewaddeyo obulina omulimu omukulu: okuwa ebitabo n’ebintu eby’Ekikristaayo eby’edda ebisingayo obulungi awatali kusasula, eri abasomi buli wamu.
about_p2: Yatandikibwa mu 2021, Ochorus etuutuukirizibwa okwewaayo okutanyeganyega okusaasaanya enjiri mu buli nsonda y’ensi, nga kikakasa nti kituukika mu nnimi n’ebyuma bingi.
about_p3: Nga tutegeera amaanyi g’ebitabo ag’okukyusa, tuzuula ebitabo eby’Ekikristaayo ebirungi ebiri mu ddembe ery’obuntu bonna, ne tubitegeka n’obwegendereza busomeke bulungi, ne tubifulumya ku mukutu guno — okusoma tewali kusasula era n’okukuuma tewali kusasula.
about_p4: Nga tukwatagana n’okwagala kwa Katonda okw’obulokozi bw’abantu bonna, kye twegomba ennyo kwe kuyamba mu kigendererwa kino eky’obwakatonda, abangi basome, balowooze, era bakyusibwe.
footer_mission: Ebitabo bya Ekikristaayo eby'edda ku yintaneeti awatali kusasula — n'ebitabo ebikube bye tugaba mu nkuŋŋaana, amakanisa, amasomero, n'amakomera mu East Africa.
about_outreach_heading: Okuva ku Lupapula okutuuka mu Nnimiro
about_outreach_p1: Ochorus si mukutu gwa yintaneeti gwokka. Mu East Africa yonna tuteeka ebitabo bya Ekikristaayo ebikube mu mikono gy'abantu — mu nkuŋŋaana z'abasumba abakulembeze b'amakanisa gye bakuŋŋaanira, ne mu makanisa, amasomero, n'amakomera gye tuyitibwa okuweereza.
about_outreach_p2: Ebitabo ebikubidwa mu Uganda bitambula okutuuka mu nkuŋŋaana mu kitundu kyonna, nga biwa amaanyi abasumba ababitwala eka eri ebibiina byabwe. Ebitabo bye bimu bye osoma wano bigabibwa bwereere — eri omuyizi, omusibe, omukkiriza omuggya — kubanga ekigambo kya Katonda tekisibibwa.
about_scripture1: Bwe kityo bwe kinaabeeranga ekigambo kyange ekiva mu kamwa kange; tekiridda gye ndi nga tekigasse, naye kinaakolanga bye njagala, era kinaalaba omukisa mu ekyo kye nkituma.
about_scripture2: Nnali mulwadde ne mujja okundaba; nnali mu kkomera ne mujja gye ndi.
about_scripture3: Ekigambo kya Kristo kibeere mu mmwe mu bujjuvu; nga muyigirizañgana era nga mubuulirirangana mu magezi gonna.
about_hero_meta: Victoria, Canada · Kampala, Uganda · Okuva mu 2021
about_hero_alt: Abakkiriza bayimusizza ebitabo bya Ochorus ebiggya ku lukuŋŋaana lw’Ekkanisa mu Uganda
about_vision_quote: Okuwa Ekkanisa mu nsi yonna ebitabo ebikulu eby’edda eby’okukkiriza kw’Abakristaayo nga bya bwereere — mu nnimi zaabwe ze zennyini, olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda.
about_pillar1_body: Ekitabo kyonna kya Ochorus kisomeka bwa bwereere era kikwatibwa bwa bwereere — tewali akaunti, tewali kusasula, tewali muwendo.
about_pillar2_body: Ekitabo kyonna kiba mu nkola yaakyo ku lulimi lwonna, omusomi n’asisinkana ebigambo mu lulimi lwe lwennyini — so si kuvvuunula kwa makina okusembayo.
about_pillar3_body: Tetukoma ku kukuba fooko n’okuteeka ku mukutu. Ekitabo kyonna eky’edda tukikola obulungi ne bafonti ezirungi ezisomeka obulungi — era tuwandiika ne tufulumya n’ebitabo bipya ebyaffe.
about_stats_intro: Ekyatandikira nga mukutu gwa yintaneeti, kaakano kifuuse layibulale n’omulimu gw’okukuba ebitabo — ebisomebwa mu nsi yonna era ebigabulwa mu nkumi mu Afrika ey’Ebuvanjuba.
about_cap_handover: Ekitabo nga kiteekeddwa mu mikono gy’omusomi ku lukuŋŋaana lw’Ekkanisa.
about_cap_school: Abayizi bakuŋŋaanira ku ssomero lwe twayitibwa okuweereza.

about_cap_staff: Abakozi nga balina ebitabo ebyaweebwayo, nga mwe muli Feasting at the Table.
about_feature_p1: Okugatta ku bitabo eby’edda ebitali bya muntu yenna, ekibinja kyaffe kiwandiika era kikuba ebitabo bipya — nga Walking with God in Academics, ekyawandiikirwa abayizi, ne Soar Like the Eagle ekya Gareth Evans.
about_feature_p2: Ebikubiddwa mu Uganda, ebitabo bino bitambula okutuuka ku nkuŋŋaana mu kitundu kyonna, nga bitegeka abasumba n’abavubuka ababitwala eka mu bibiina byabwe eby’okusinza, mu bibiina by’okuyiga, ne mu maka gaabwe.
about_feature_alt_box: Akasanduuko akajjudde emikanda emiggya egy’okukubibwa egya Walking with God in Academics

about_partner_heading: Bitwalibwa Mikwano Abeesigwa Awo Ku Ttaka
about_partner_body: Omulimu gwaffe mu Buvanjuba bwa Afrika gutambula nga guyita mu bakolagana ab’omu kitundu abeesigwa — mulimu The Uganda Partnership Society, ekibiina eky’Abakristaayo ekyagatta Ekkanisa za Canada n’emirimu gy’obuweereza mu Uganda mu by’okuyiga, okulabirira abaana, n’okukulaakulanya eby’omwoyo okuva mu 2008. Abantu baabwe be baggulawo enzigi; ebitabo byaffe bye biyita mu zo.
about_cta_heading: Ekitabo Kyonna Eky’edda. Olulimi Lwonna. Bwereere.
about_cta_body: Ggulawo layibulale otandike — oba tukwatagane, tubeere bakolagana mu mulimu guno mu kukuba ebitabo ne mu kusaba.
legal_meta_description: Engeri Ochorus gy'ekwatamu eby'ekyama byo n'ebiragiro by'okukozesa etterekero: soma bwereere awatali akawunti, awatali bulambe, awatali bugoberezi, era n'obuyinza obujjuvu ku data yo ey'okusoma.
legal_intro: Ochorus mulimu gwa bwereere ogufulumya ebitabo bya Ekikristaayo eby'edda okusomebwa ku yintaneeti era nga gugaba ebitabo ebikube mu East Africa. Olupapula luno lunnyonnyola, mu ngeri ennyangu, engeri gye tukwatamu amawulire go n'ebiragiro eby'okukozesa omukutu.
legal_privacy_p1: Osobola okusoma laibulale yonna awatali akawunti. Bw'otoyingira, by'oyagala n'ebikwata ku kusoma kwo — we otuuse mu kitabo, ebye owandiiseeko, obubaka, obubonero, n'ennaku ze wasoma — bisigala mu bbulawuza yo ku kyuma kino era tebituweebwa ffe.
legal_privacy_p2: Bw'okola akawunti, tutereka endagiriro yo eya email (nga tuyita mu abo abatuyamba mu kuyingira) era tugatta ebikwata ku kusoma kwo ku akawunti yo, osobole okusoma ku ssimu ne ku kompyuta yo. Eyo y'ensonga yokka lwe tugikwatirira.
legal_privacy_p3: Tetutunda bikwata ku ggwe, tetulaga bulangirizi, era tetukozesa bikessi bya bulangirizi wadde eby'emikutu egy'enjawulo. Tetukozesa kkuki eziketta, era tetukuŋŋaanya email yo lwa katale.
legal_privacy_p4: Twesigama ku bawa obuweereza babiri okutambuza omukutu: Supabase (okuyingira n'etterekero ly'ebikwata) ne Render (okusigaza omukutu). Ebikwata ku ggwe biterekebwa gye bali ku lwaffe.
legal_privacy_p5: Ggwe oli mu buyinza: osobola okuggya oba okusangula ebikwata ku kusoma kwo ekiseera kyonna mu Nteekateeka, era okusangula akawunti yo kiggyawo ebikwata bye tukukuumira.
legal_terms_p1: Laibulale ya bwereere okusoma n'okukuuma. Ebitabo ebisinga biri mu bantu bonna; ebitabo n'enkyusa za Ochorus zennyini ziweebwa lwa kusoma kw'omuntu ku bubwe, si kwa busuubuzi.
legal_terms_p2: Enkyusa ezimu zikolebwa nga ziyambibwako AI era ziteekebwako akabonero nti zilinda okwekebejjebwa abazaaliranwa. Tusaba otwale enkyusa etannaakebejjebwa ng'omulimu ogukyagenda mu maaso, si nkomerero.
legal_terms_p3: Omukutu guweebwa nga bwe guli, awatali bukakafu. Tufuba nnyo okugukuuma nga gwa mazima era nga gukolawo, naye tetuyinza kukakasa nti bulijjo tegujja kubaamu nsobi oba nti tegujja kusalibwako.
legal_terms_p4: Tusaba okozese Ochorus olw'ekigendererwa kyayo — okusoma n'okugabana ebitabo bya Ekikristaayo — era togezaako kutaataaganya oba kukozesa bubi buweereza.
legal_terms_p5: Tuyinza okukyusa olupapula luno buli kiseera; ennaku eri wansi eraga we lwakyusibwa okusembayo.

sermons_meta_description: Okubuulira okw'Ekikristaayo okw'edda — okusoma tewali kusasula. Ekigambo ekyabuulirwa eky'abawandiisi b'ebitabo by'osobola okusoma ku Ochorus.

scripture_tagline: Buli kyokulabirako kya Bayibuli mu tterekero kiwandiikiddwa. Zino ze ssuula abawandiisi ze baddamu — ggulawo emu olabe eyagibuulira, n’ekyo kye yayogera.

feedback_intro: Ekigambo ku biwandiiko, ku bikwatibwako, oba ku kintu ky'oyagala tukole — tusoma buli kimu.
notebook_empty_journal: Olupapula luno lwo. Wandiika ekirowoozo, eky'okuyiga, oba olunyiriri olukwogeddeko leero.
notebook_empty_prayers: Wandiika ky'osabira — oluvannyuma okomewo okiteekeko akabonero nti kiddiddwamu.
notebook_empty_answered: Essaala bw'eddibwamu, giteekeko akabonero wano: ekijjukizo ky'obwesigwa bwa Katonda.
notebook_ref_placeholder: Ekyawandiikibwa oba ekitundu (si kya tteeka), ng'Zabbuli 23
notebook_how_answered_placeholder: Si kya tteeka — wandiika ekyabaawo, okijjukire.
notebook_remind_hint: Kyongera ekintu ekiddiŋŋana ku kalenda yo, okujjukizibwa kutuuke ku buli kyuma ky'okozesa. Okukiyimiriza, sangula ekintu ekyo eyo.
notebook_daily_intro: Eddakiika ntono ezikulembeddwa: okusinza, okwatula, okwebaza, okusaba.
notebook_daily_saved: Essaala yo eterekeddwa mu kitabo kyo.
notebook_daily_placeholder: Wandiika wano, oba saba bussabi weeyongereyo…
notebook_step_q_adore: Katonda y'ani gy'oli leero? Mutendereze olw'ebyo by'ali.
notebook_step_q_confess: Kiki ky'olina okuleeta mu kitangaala? Saba okusonyiyibwa kwe.
notebook_step_q_ask: Weetaaga ki, era ani yeetaaga obuyambi bwe? Baleete gy'ali.

feedback_edit_intro: Tubuulire ekisomeka obubi — era, bw'oba oyagala, kye kyandibadde kigamba.
originals_title: Ebitabo ebipya, ebiwandiikiddwa wamu n’ebitabo eby’edda
originals_lede: Ebitabo ebisinga mu tterekero lyaffe bya myaka bikumi na bikumi. Ochorus Originals bye bitabo bye tuwandiika ffe bennyini: okufumiitiriza okwa buli lunaku eri abaana, emboozi ez’amazima ez’abasajja n’abakazi abaatwala enjiri, n’okuyita okusaba eri abakulembera. Nga buli kimu wano, buli kimu kisomebwa bwereere.
originals_why_body: Ebitabo eby’edda byogera olulimi lw’ekyasa kyabyo. Ochorus Originals biddamu okunyumya obulamu n’amazima ago eri omwana ng’agenda kwebaka, omuyizi ng’agenda kukola bigezo, oba omusumba ku Ssande ekiro — nga biggyibwa mu nsibuko ze zimu ezijjuza etterekero lyonna.
originals_langs_body: Ebimu ku Originals byavvuunulwa. Londa olulimi olabe ekisenge kyalwo.
originals_meta_title: Ochorus Originals — ebitabo ebipya eby’Ekikristaayo eri abaana, abavubuka n’abakulembeze
originals_meta_description: Okufumiitiriza okw’obwereere, emboozi ez’amazima ez’okukkiriza n’ebitabo ku kusaba n’obukulembeze, ebiwandiikiddwa Ochorus eri abasomi ab’ennaku zino.
